title: AC3 email sender identity + template tags are unobservable to the suite (incl. send_reminder never exercised with ReminderTwo)
evidence:
send.gleam:30 `const referee_sender: String = "RightTenantry References <references@righttenantry.ie>"` and send.gleam:34 `const standard_sender: String = "RightTenantry <noreply@app.righttenantry.ie>"` are only referenced inside the non-empty-key branch (send.gleam:194-203): `case deps.resend_api_key {
        "" -> skip_email_no_key(template)
        api_key ->
          email_client.send_email_with_tags(
            api_key,
            referee_sender,` — every send_test.gleam case uses `no_key_deps()`, so the short-circuit fires before any sender/tag is observable. The only stage exercise is send_test.gleam:58-59 `pub fn send_reminder_no_keys_skips_both_channels_test() {
  send.send_reminder(no_key_deps(), messages.ReminderOne, fixture_message())` (ReminderTwo never passed), leaving send.gleam:94-95 `messages.ReminderOne -> "reference_reminder_1"` / `messages.ReminderTwo -> "reference_reminder_2"` unpinned. Grep over server/test/ for referee_sender|standard_sender|references@righttenantry|reference_invite|reference_reminder|reference_co_nudge|reference_warm_handoff returns only server/test/notification/email_client_test.gleam:789 (email_client's own build_send_body test for a different caller).
detail: A typo in either sender constant, a swapped referee/applicant sender, or a wrong template tag would pass the suite green. AC3's email half has zero observable coverage; the repo's pure-builder seam (email_client.build_send_body, sms_client build_send_request tests) exists but send.gleam exposes no equivalent.
recommended_fix: Expose a pure sender/tag selection (or build via email_client.build_send_body) and pin: referee_sender for invite/reminders, standard_sender for co-nudge/warm-handoff, the four reference_* tags, and ReminderTwo through send_reminder.

title: Warm-handoff attempt-line empty-detail branch unpinned (both fixtures carry non-empty detail)
detail: P3 render branch: a delivered/skipped attempt with no provider id renders without the parenthesised suffix; that output shape is untested, so a regression in the empty-detail arm would not fail the suite.
recommended_fix: Add an AttemptEntry with detail: "" to the warm-handoff test and assert the line renders as `at: channel, outcome` with no trailing parenthesis.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: P0 coverage is pinned by verbatim test entry points: `pub fn no_em_dash_in_any_template_test() {`, `pub fn no_reply_stop_anywhere_test() {`, `pub fn invite_sms_carries_form_notice_and_stop_links_test() {`, `pub fn send_invite_no_keys_skips_both_channels_test() {`, `pub fn email_outcome_maps_ok_to_delivered_with_id_test() {`. The P1 gap is the unpinned AC3 email seam: send.gleam:30 `const referee_sender: String = "RightTenantry References <references@righttenantry.ie>"` reachable only past the send_test-never-taken non-empty-key branch, with send_test.gleam:59 `send.send_reminder(no_key_deps(), messages.ReminderOne, fixture_message())` the only stage exercise.
detail: P0 100% (Art 14 block, stop-link in all 3 SMS, no reply-STOP, no-op-without-keys, outcome mapping, em-dash ban all pinned). P1 ~88% (7/8 behaviours; AC3 email sender/tag wiring uncovered). Overall ~93% (14/15, one P3 boundary gap). P1 sits in the 80-89 band: CONCERNS.
recommended_fix: Pin the sender/tag seam per finding 1 (pure selection or build_send_body) and add the empty-detail attempt-line test per finding 2; that lifts P1 to 100% and overall to ~100%, raising the gate to PASS.
